(b) Reuters World and AP were blocked and two web searches found no dated top-story list for the day, so list (b) is missing; Wikipedia items citing Reuters/AP were not counted as (b), as in the 2026-10-28 file. ČTK-only items (Pavel–Stubb call about the Putin call, WSJ: Vance letter to Iran, Trump on a Putin–Zelensky meeting, Oleshky truce holding per AP, Rubio's holiday message, Politico: EU drops associate membership for Canada, Klaus on statehood, Vučić coup report) and ČT24-only items (sea drones hit cargo ship in the Black Sea, Moldova security council after cyberattack, Siberian permafrost methane study) did not qualify. events.title: Two high-speed trains collide between Los Yébenes and Urda (Toledo, Spain): at least 68 dead, 179 injured; minister blames a dispatcher error; a Czech citizen among the missing
events.note: Accident; not announced in advance and not foreseeable by any sweep. Happened after the evening planning; only a morning refresh of the running lists could have added it.

events.title: Israel count: Netanyahu's bloc leads (about 54 seats at 84.5% counted) but has no majority; Arab parties strengthen; Likud accuses Arab parties of stealing the election
Flávio Bolsonaro lands near Miami and declares himself Brazil's rightful president-elect; Lula accuses the US of colluding with him
events.note: The edition's story asked whether he would file an annulment request; the self-proclamation from the US was not foreseen (the planning file kept 'publicly recognises Lula's victory' only as a dropped fallback).

events.title: Knife attacker wounds a police officer outside Israel's embassy in Belgrade and is shot dead
events.note: Attack; not announced in advance and not foreseeable.

events.title: Independence Day at Prague Castle: Pavel's speech warns against ignoring crises and rash changes; 51 people decorated (Čáslavská, Forman, Janžurová)
Vítkov memorial ceremony for the 108th anniversary of Czechoslovakia; Pavel promotes 16 generals, Hlaváč to army general
events.note: Both in the dropped list: generals' appointment 'practically certain (promotions announced by the Castle); low uncertainty value'; Vítkov ceremony 'ceremonial; no open checkable outcome beyond attendance (covered via the Vladislav Hall claims)'.

events.title: Students' Solidarity Committee calls a 3 Nov strike over the licence-fee abolition; holiday rallies for ČT and ČRo in Brno, Plzeň and Hradec Králové
events.note: The edition's fee story covered the dispute (coalition deal, Okamura recall motion). The holiday protests themselves were in the dropped list: 'no protest announced for 28 Oct (Milion chvilek next rally 15 Nov); speculative'.

events.title: Pellegrini: Slovakia can again fully protect its own airspace (F-16s in service, ending allied air policing incl. Czech)
events.note: Announced by the president on the 28 Oct anniversary; no advance notice of the announcement found in the sweep (not checked further, search cap). Could only have been foreseen from Slovak defence-ministry F-16 delivery news.

events.title: Russia and Ukraine report dead and wounded after mutual strikes: injuries in Kharkiv, Ukraine hits a Russian chemical plant
events.note: Daily war strikes; not announced. The edition's ua-peace story covered diplomacy only; the planning file dropped an Oleshky-truce claim but had no strikes item. ct24 = front page (not in its evening SOUHRN).

events.title: Reuters: US cost of the war on Iran exceeds $47bn
events.note: A Reuters calculation published on the day, not a scheduled event; not announced in advance. The us-iran story covered the talks track only. ct24 = front page (not in its SOUHRN).
